meta.description: WS-04 Phase 2/3 milestones: polls document status via WS-02's API. 'failed' documents are automatically retried via POST .../auto-retry, bounded by DOCUMENT_AUTO_RETRY_MAX on the backend (Progress.md Blockers #4 -- previously this workflow only surfaced failures for a human). Documents stuck in 'queued'/'processing' for >15 minutes are still only logged in n8n's execution history for a human/WS-06 to act on, since re-dispatching the same pipeline wouldn't fix a wedged worker/broker (ADR-009).
